# Google Photos Toolkit parser

`google-photos-toolkit/parser.ts` and `types/index.ts` are vendored from xob0t/Google-Photos-Toolkit at commit `cd1db961c6eacc5a3bc20304b559770ea152d930`, under its included MIT license. The parser's type import path is adapted for this directory. The RPC request shapes in `src/google.js` follow the same MIT toolkit's `src/api/api.ts`.

Source: https://github.com/xob0t/Google-Photos-Toolkit/tree/cd1db961c6eacc5a3bc20304b559770ea152d930

No Google Photos Deduper source is included. This extension uses its own UI, state management, and Chrome integration.
